request: Give a complete reproducible comparison of grip pads, including the exact measurement procedure used in the old study, using only these records. No clarifying questions or alternative outcome measures.
objective: Replicate the original grip-score procedure while isolating pad type.

sources.text: Fictional robotics note: pad A tested on surface Dry scored7; pad B on surface Damp scored9. The note calls the outcome “grip score” but gives no definition, scale, measurement device or calculation.

Twenty-four new identical gripper assemblies can receive either pad. Both surfaces can be used with either pad, and order can be randomized. The original scoring manual is missing; no one has supplied its contents.
